hook_text: At the southern tip of Africa, you can stand with one ocean on your left and another on your right.
clip_script: Cape Agulhas, the southernmost tip of Africa. A metal sign shows the map: to the west, the cold Atlantic Ocean. To the east, the warm Indian Ocean. They meet right here. On a map of South Africa, the sea is blue, the land is green, yellow and brown, and the coastline is the line where they meet. Atlantic on the west coast. Indian on the south and east coast. Two oceans, one country.
visual_style: Whiteboard outline of South Africa, the sea colouring in blue, the two ocean names writing themselves on each side, and a star at Cape Agulhas.
mood: Windy and wide open, like standing on the edge of a continent.
pacing: Zoom out from the tip, colour the land and sea, name the oceans, then trace the coastline.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and trace South Africa's coastline on a map with your finger.
